severity_grid.missing_freeze: Not applicable; duration is the severity dimension.

metric_definitions.precision: Correct fault-class diagnoses divided by predicted diagnoses of that class.
metric_definitions.recall: Correct fault-class diagnoses divided by injected points.
metric_definitions.accepted_repair_coverage: Accepted injected-point repairs divided by injected points.
metric_definitions.unresolved_rate: Unresolved injected points divided by injected points.
metric_definitions.normalized_error: Accepted repair absolute error divided by robust training reference scale, aggregated across accepted points.
metric_definitions.within_tolerance_rate: Accepted repairs within 1.5x robust training reference scale divided by accepted repairs.

grid_note: Only channel counts supported by each group are included: the dataset has one power channel and two flow channels. Each repeat uses a distinct deterministically selected validation cycle when enough cycles are available. One-second freeze cells are included as inherently ambiguous single-sample cases; they are reported, not tuned as detectable.
